nodes.label: Grok isolation
nodes.rationale: The model receives no tools, credentials or transport access; explicit backend functions own all network operations.

nodes.label: Human approval
nodes.rationale: Schema and membership checks reduce integrity failures but cannot guarantee ranking correctness.

nodes.label: Cohort median summary
nodes.rationale: A shared summary below the six-card grid condenses revenue, reviews and launch-price context.

nodes.label: Fact and estimate badges
nodes.rationale: Separate modeled revenue and copies from Steam reviews, prices and release dates directly within each game card.

nodes.label: Pending preview
nodes.rationale: Process-local state is bounded to 100 records and expires after 30 minutes; discovery and expensive collection are separate lifecycles.

nodes.label: Fixture-first development
nodes.rationale: Fresh clones run without corpus or keys so parallel lanes are not blocked.

nodes.label: Frozen shared types
nodes.rationale: Stable shared types allow parallel work without contract churn.

nodes.label: Pure scoring functions
nodes.rationale: Explicit today and synchronous arithmetic make scoring deterministic and testable.

nodes.label: Corpus and concept embedding symmetry
nodes.rationale: Identical field construction prevents silent similarity degradation.

nodes.label: L2-normalized row-major vectors
nodes.rationale: Moves normalization offline so runtime cosine is a dot product.

nodes.label: Source-priority normalization
nodes.rationale: First available source wins; missing remains null and every value is labelled.

nodes.label: Stratified Steam-tag sampling
nodes.rationale: Balances genre coverage rather than allowing shooter dominance.

nodes.label: Corpus verification invariants
nodes.rationale: Detects row mismatch and embedding corruption before demo.

nodes.label: Missing-component reweighting
nodes.rationale: Drop unavailable factors and renormalize active weights.

nodes.label: Cohort-median reception
nodes.rationale: A reference bar is defensible; unbuilt game quality cannot be predicted.

nodes.label: Weekly release risk
nodes.rationale: Date confidence distributes threat across possible weeks.

nodes.label: Similarity-weighted revenue percentiles
nodes.rationale: Squared similarity prioritizes close comparables; unknown revenue produces null rather than zero.

nodes.label: Competitive threat
nodes.rationale: Release risk consumes upstream threat once rather than multiplying similarity again.

nodes.label: Directory-specific coverage thresholds
nodes.rationale: High scoring coverage avoids meaningless UI coverage inflation.

nodes.label: Embedding symmetry invariant
nodes.rationale: Catches silent corpus/concept text divergence.

nodes.label: Thorough pure scoring tests
nodes.rationale: Wrong scores look plausible; this is where correctness is invisible.

nodes.label: needs_clarification
nodes.rationale: Low confidence, missing required tags, or questions prevent IGDB search.

nodes.label: Approved live collection
nodes.rationale: Failed approved games appear as failures and are never silently replaced.

nodes.label: Atomic preview lifecycle
nodes.rationale: 30-minute bounded process memory prevents concurrent collection and reuse.

nodes.label: ready_for_approval preview
nodes.rationale: Contains candidate names and match rationale without expensive statistics.

nodes.label: Dark blue gradient layout
nodes.rationale: Large welcome headline, contrasting entry actions, and four sequential cards explain the game-to-launch workflow.

nodes.label: Expanded week explanation
nodes.rationale: Combines who launches, score rationale, and mitigation actions in one selected-week card.

nodes.label: FACT Steam and PREDICTION engine labels
nodes.norm_label: fact steam and prediction engine labels
nodes.rationale: Separates observed competitor identities from modeled collision scores.

nodes.label: Snapshot
nodes.rationale: One frozen object keeps dashboard, calendar, and exports consistent.

nodes.label: ADR-003 canonical Steam AppID
nodes.rationale: Steam scope permits a verified build-time identity join.

nodes.label: ADR-007 arithmetic forecasts
nodes.rationale: LLM only structures prose; deterministic comparable arithmetic is traceable.

nodes.label: ADR-012 labelled Boxleiter fallback
nodes.rationale: Missing commercial estimates use a visible review-count heuristic.

nodes.label: ADR-004 brute-force vector search
nodes.rationale: At 4200 rows exact search costs little and avoids ANN dependencies and recall failures.

nodes.label: ADR-011 date confidence weighting
nodes.rationale: Spread uncertain dates rather than fabricate precise dates or understate competition.

nodes.label: ADR-013 desktop-first
nodes.rationale: Dense analysis and projector use justify desktop focus with usable mobile fallback.

nodes.label: ADR-005 offline IGDB REST
nodes.rationale: Preserves ownership and explainability of ranking while avoiding beta live dependencies.

nodes.label: ADR-002 no database
nodes.rationale: Immutable corpus and browser sessions do not need mutable server storage.

nodes.label: ADR-001 offline demo data
nodes.rationale: Avoid provider latency and rate limits on the demo path.

nodes.label: ADR-009 browser print PDF
nodes.rationale: Avoids headless-browser infrastructure and runtime failure paths.

nodes.label: ADR-006 forecast ranges
nodes.rationale: Two significant figures and sample counts disclose uncertainty.

nodes.label: ADR-008 frozen snapshot
nodes.rationale: Prevents inconsistent numbers across dashboard and exports.

nodes.label: ADR-010 tag prefilter
nodes.rationale: Tags remove semantic false positives; relaxing below 60 preserves recall.

nodes.label: PDF and JSON export
nodes.rationale: Both read the same frozen snapshot.

nodes.label: Progressive disclosure
nodes.rationale: Unlock sections only when underlying data exists.

nodes.label: Frozen analysis snapshot
nodes.rationale: Editing increments concept version and marks stale without mixing old and new values.

nodes.label: Expanded week explanation
nodes.rationale: Combines who launches, score rationale, and mitigation actions in one selected-week card.

nodes.norm_label: planned week selector and horizon toggle

nodes.label: FACT Steam and PREDICTION engine labels
nodes.norm_label: fact steam and prediction engine labels
nodes.rationale: Separates observed competitor identities from modeled collision scores.

nodes.label: Dark blue gradient layout
nodes.rationale: Large welcome headline, contrasting entry actions, and four sequential cards explain the game-to-launch workflow.

nodes.label: Direct AppID collection
nodes.rationale: Explicit IDs bypass Grok.

nodes.label: Fresh no-store collection
nodes.rationale: No complete records or snapshots persist between requests; providers are called afresh.

nodes.label: Partial success with typed provider issues
nodes.norm_label: partial success with typed provider issues
nodes.rationale: Optional provider failure does not discard successfully loaded Steam games.

nodes.label: Dark console with pale input cards
nodes.norm_label: dark console with pale input cards

nodes.label: Similar games selector
nodes.rationale: Optional known comparables provide gameplay anchors alongside prose and genre selections.

nodes.label: Typed collection issues
nodes.rationale: Optional provider failures preserve the valid Steam game with null or empty fields; complete Steam failure returns provider unavailable.

nodes.label: DEMO_MODE fixture interception
nodes.rationale: Default fixture prevents unrecognized input from throwing.

nodes.label: Demo freeze protocol
nodes.rationale: Stable final artifacts prevent late shared-state regressions.

nodes.label: Local recorded fallback
nodes.rationale: Venue connectivity is excluded from the last-resort path.

nodes.label: Disabled Find comparables action
nodes.rationale: Empty description visibly gates progression.

nodes.label: Moment-to-moment gameplay textarea
nodes.rationale: Focuses the input on what players do.

nodes.label: GameConcept diff loop
nodes.rationale: Apply only justified changed fields to preserve taxonomy across turns and avoid slow, expensive full re-extraction.

nodes.label: Keyword fallback
nodes.rationale: Deterministic offline completion lets AI outages reduce quality without ending the demo.

nodes.label: Symmetric embedding builders
nodes.rationale: Identical corpus/query field order and normalization improve retrieval and make cosine a dot product.

nodes.label: Field provenance
nodes.rationale: Never blend sources; modeled numbers carry method and estimated markers, and missing values remain null.

nodes.label: Shortlist enrichment
nodes.rationale: Enrich only likely comparables because free-tier quota cannot cover the entire corpus.

nodes.label: Browser session state
nodes.rationale: localStorage removes server sessions and database infrastructure at the cost of cross-device synchronization.

nodes.label: Offline pipeline
nodes.rationale: Legacy corpus architecture consumes unreliable provider APIs before the demo to eliminate live provider failures.

nodes.label: Snapshot
nodes.rationale: Deep-frozen analysis keeps dashboard, calendar and exports consistent; concept edits mark it stale.

nodes.label: Approval request
nodes.rationale: Defer prices, reviews, comments and estimates until explicit approval, allowing rejection before expensive traffic.

nodes.label: Candidate normalization
nodes.rationale: Deduplicate IDs, discard empty descriptions, bound plain text and enforce multiplayer mode evidence before Grok ranking.

nodes.label: Horizontal scaling
nodes.rationale: Process-local previews disappear on restart and require sticky routing or a future shared store across deployment instances.

nodes.label: similar-games-data-collector
nodes.rationale: Separate discovery judgments from live facts, avoiding persisted game records, revenue predictions and UI responsibilities.

nodes.label: Claim release
nodes.rationale: Invalid selections and unexpected collection errors release the claim so callers can retry within TTL.

nodes.label: Selected AppID subset
nodes.rationale: Collect only displayed approved games in original ranking order; never silently replace failed games.

nodes.label: Readiness rules
nodes.rationale: Ready requires confidence at least 0.65, at least two unique tags including one required tag, and no questions.

nodes.label: Partial success
nodes.rationale: no_matches and incomplete previews are valid outcomes; approved collection may contain usable games alongside per-game failures.

nodes.label: Missing revenue
nodes.rationale: Keep missing revenue null with missing_field issue rather than multiplying present-day price by estimated sales.

nodes.label: Discovery smoke checks
nodes.rationale: Preview and approval execute in one smoke process so the in-memory preview remains available.

nodes.label: Ready for approval
nodes.rationale: Expose only Steam AppID, IGDB ID, name, match reason and tags; full descriptions and live statistics are withheld.

nodes.label: Fetch timestamps
nodes.rationale: Record retrieval completion rather than claiming upstream dataset freshness.

nodes.label: Grok match evidence
nodes.rationale: Keep AI reasons separate from provenance of collected facts.

nodes.label: Provider request gates
nodes.rationale: Synchronous slot reservation avoids concurrent calls sharing slots; process-local gates cannot coordinate deployment instances.

nodes.label: Quota cooldown
nodes.rationale: 429 responses cause at least a 60-second cooldown rather than immediate retry.

nodes.label: Recent English comments
nodes.rationale: Comments are separate from aggregate totals, capped at three, and omit author identifiers.

nodes.label: USD-only nullable pricing
nodes.rationale: Missing or non-USD prices remain null to avoid guessed conversions.

nodes.label: Exact identity join
nodes.rationale: Name collisions and editions make fuzzy names unsafe; ambiguous mappings are omitted.

nodes.label: Required explicit constraints
nodes.rationale: Inferred details remain preferred so guesses cannot become hard filters.

nodes.label: Validated tag set
nodes.rationale: Ranking may report only exact names accepted in validation.

nodes.label: POST /api/analyze
nodes.rationale: Recompute cohort scores and query upcoming PC releases; failed release data yields INSUFFICIENT_DATA instead of false zero risk.

nodes.label: Membership validation
nodes.rationale: Reject the entire ranking for unknown or duplicate IDs and invented or duplicate matched tags.

nodes.label: Verified Steam shortlist
nodes.rationale: Up to twenty ranked results reserve candidates lacking exact Steam identity, without substitutions after approval.

nodes.label: needs_clarification
nodes.rationale: Stop before search and preview creation to avoid wasting provider capacity on vague descriptions.

nodes.label: Free-game price normalization
nodes.rationale: Free games are excluded from price-normalization division.

nodes.label: Measured zero similarity
nodes.rationale: A measured zero remains zero and must remain distinct from absent semantic evidence.

nodes.label: Missing semantic evidence
nodes.rationale: Missing evidence is null, omitted from the weighted denominator, and displayed as unavailable.

nodes.label: Tag overlap
nodes.rationale: Tag overlap is never labeled semantic evidence; corpus semantic evidence uses compatible text embeddings.

nodes.label: Unavailable revenue ranges
nodes.rationale: Without revenue evidence, return unavailable ranges rather than zero-dollar estimates.

nodes.label: Deterministic scoring
nodes.rationale: Functions are synchronous and provider-independent; current time and source records are explicit inputs.
